slides.headline: Buyers decide in 10 seconds
slides.say: Selling your home in George? Buyers decide in the first ten seconds. Here's what they notice.

slides.headline: The front door
slides.body: A clean entrance and fresh paint set the tone.
slides.say: One. The front door. A clean entrance and fresh paint set the tone before they even step inside.

slides.headline: The smell
slides.body: Fresh air beats any air freshener.
slides.say: Two. The smell. Open the windows. Fresh air beats any air freshener.

slides.headline: The light
slides.body: Open every curtain. Switch on every light.
slides.say: Three. The light. Open every curtain and switch on every light. Bright rooms feel bigger.
